Given \(Q=0.025\ \text{m}^3\!/\text{s}\), \(D=0.10\ \text{m}\), \(\rho=998\ \text{kg/m}^3\), \(\mu=1.00\times 10^{-3}\ \text{Pa·s}\), \(L=150\ \text{m}\), \(\varepsilon=0.046\ \text{mm}=4.6\times 10^{-5}\ \text{m}\), \(\sum K=5.5\), \(g=9.81\ \text{m/s}^2\).

Pipe velocity:
\[
A=\frac{\pi D^2}{4}=\frac{\pi(0.10)^2}{4}=7.854\times 10^{-3}\ \text{m}^2
\]
\[
V=\frac{Q}{A}=\frac{0.025}{7.854\times 10^{-3}}=3.183\ \text{m/s}
\]

---

### (a) Reynolds number
\[
\mathrm{Re}=\frac{\rho V D}{\mu}=\frac{(998)(3.183)(0.10)}{1.00\times 10^{-3}}=3.18\times 10^{5}
\]

---

### (b) Darcy friction factor (Colebrook)
Relative roughness:
\[
\frac{\varepsilon}{D}=\frac{4.6\times10^{-5}}{0.10}=4.6\times10^{-4}
\]
Colebrook equation:
\[
\frac{1}{\sqrt{f}}=-2\log_{10}\!\left(\frac{\varepsilon}{3.7D}+\frac{2.51}{\mathrm{Re}\sqrt{f}}\right)
\]
Iterating gives \(f \approx 0.0179\).

---

### (c) Total pump head
Velocity head term:
\[
\frac{V^2}{2g}=\frac{(3.183)^2}{2(9.81)}=0.5166\ \text{m}
\]
Major (pipe friction) head loss:
\[
h_f=f\frac{L}{D}\frac{V^2}{2g}=(0.0179)\left(\frac{150}{0.10}\right)(0.5166)=13.87\ \text{m}
\]
Minor losses:
\[
h_m=\left(\sum K\right)\frac{V^2}{2g}=(5.5)(0.5166)=2.84\ \text{m}
\]
Total pump head (including static lift \(\Delta z=12\ \text{m}\)):
\[
H_p=\Delta z+h_f+h_m=12+13.87+2.84=28.71\ \text{m}
\]

---

### (d) Pump shaft power (72% efficiency)
Hydraulic power:
\[
P_h=\rho g Q H_p=(998)(9.81)(0.025)(28.71)=7.03\times 10^3\ \text{W}=7.03\ \text{kW}
\]
Shaft power:
\[
P_{\text{shaft}}=\frac{P_h}{\eta}=\frac{7.03}{0.72}=9.76\ \text{kW}
\]

FINAL (a): 3.18×10^5 dimensionless  
FINAL (b): 0.0179 dimensionless  
FINAL (c): 28.71 m  
FINAL (d): 9.76 kW
